status: Design candidate, pending user art review; no production integration
request: 整体护盾重新设计；统一效果，仅花纹和颜色不同

sharedGeometry.shape: One translucent full-body ellipsoidal energy shell for every profession
sharedGeometry.rim: Common softly layered narrow rim with restrained bloom
sharedGeometry.pattern: Large, sparse, thicker readable motifs curved along the shell; common placement and weight

sharedMotion.formation: Shell resolves upward from the feet and motifs connect behind the same reveal front
sharedMotion.sustain: Subtle common breathing and slow energy flow; no profession-specific extra emitters
sharedMotion.hit: One local impact ripple on the actual contact side, then immediately return to the resting brightness
sharedMotion.naturalFade: Pattern brightness recedes, then rim and thin membrane dissolve in place
sharedMotion.break: Common brief shell breakup and fade; no offensive blast
sharedMotion.duration: Read the real shield lifetime. Preview examples are illustrative and do not change gameplay.

WAR.name: 战士
WAR.pattern: Paired blade points and angular guard curls

BOW.name: 弓系
BOW.pattern: Sweeping wind curves and subtle arrow-like tips

invariants: Identical shell silhouette, dimensions, surface transparency, rim width, bloom, motif placement, motion and response across variants
The only per-profession differences are motif line shape and hue
Existing accepted profession motifs supply the decorative vocabulary; no ground skill circle is added
Visual themes do not add shield skills or change damage reduction, shield amount, duration or cooldown
previewLimits: Composited design animation over existing native 3D game footage. It is not an engine material, depth test, moving character attachment, real impact detection, or a production implementation.
